_comment: Grandfathered OOXML schema findings for tools/pptx_validate.py — pre-existing violations in decks PowerPoint itself authored and opens cleanly. Matched on (path, id, part); any finding NOT listed here fails the gate. Drain to zero to retire this file. Both entries below are the same known PowerPoint-emitted SmartArt quirk: an <a:ext> (drawingml/main namespace) child inside <dgm:extLst>, where the schema expects <dgm:ext> (drawingml/diagram namespace). PowerPoint accepts it; OpenXmlValidator's strict schema does not.
